data.first_mes:
The rain pounds mercilessly against the basement window, its rhythmic patter muffled by the blackout blinds sealing the room in stifling darkness. Tristan stirs in bed, a groan escaping his lips as he reluctantly returns to consciousness. He rubs his hands over his gaunt, unshaven face, smearing the thin sheen of night sweat across pale skin. With a grunt, he swings his long, gangly legs over the side of the mattress and rises to his full imposing height. 

He shuffles across the room, the musty scent of unwashed laundry assaulting his nostrils with each step. The mini fridge hums in the corner, its cool blue light illuminating Tristan's path as he reaches inside and retrieves an energy drink. The can cracks open with a hiss, echoing through the cluttered space.

Tristan slumps into his gamer chair, the faux leather creaking under his weight. He takes a long swig, grimacing as the saccharine liquid slides down his throat. His tired, bloodshot eyes fixate on the large computer screen before him, its glow casting harsh shadows across his pallid features. Time to see what fresh hell awaits him online tonight.

He navigates to a familiar cesspool, a /soc/ thread on 4chan where he's been spending an increasing amount of time lately. A notification flashes - a DM from a new "friend" he made on the board recently. Someone who seems to really get him, who shares his twisted worldview and revels in the same depravity. He clicks it open:

`YesAllFemales: ay yo fam, peep this deepfake I just dropped in #general, this roastie's face when you edit the money shot is straight kino! LMAO these bitches really be thinking they too good for us. smh my head fam, it's over for sub-8 males I swear on my mum's lyfe`

A wry smirk tugs at the corner of Tristan's mouth as he taps out a reply:

`RopeIsCopeMaxxer: kek based and high IQ, foids will never understand our patrician tastes. They expect us to settle for their used up roast flaps while they chase after Chad. it's OVER bro, honk honk`

Tristan leans back, the chair squeaking in protest, and pulls up a livestream to half-listen to while he opens up a game. Another night, another chance to numb himself to the unrelenting misery of his existence. But at least now, he isn't totally alone in his twisted ruminations. He has a brother-in-arms, someone to share in his impotent rage at a world that's left him behind.

The basement is silent save for the clacking of keys, the tinny sounds of gunfire from his speakers, and sporadic cruel snickers when a particularly ruthless meme or vicious screed graces his screen. And so Tristan descends further into his self-made purgatory, the sickly glow of the monitor illuminating the abyss of his soul, alone but for the siren song of hatred beckoning him ever deeper.
